title: History 537: Bug 1903910 - When saving the selection, use message URIs instead of keys. r=aleca This is somehow just as fast, if we ignore a bunch of notifications about the data changing while restoring the selection. `FindIndexOfMsgHdr` behaves very differently to `FindIndexFromKey` which causes the notifications.
